codeReview.summary: The feature adds a compact SVG elevation profile and wires it into TripDetail with day-aware filtering, but it does not fully satisfy the axis-label/unit requirements from the feature contract.

issues.description: The chart does not provide full labeled axes as specified (elevation in ft/m on Y and distance on X). It renders corner value badges only, and only in imperial units (ft/mi), with no metric elevation/distance labeling on the chart axes.
getX() divides by (maxX - minX) without guarding the zero-range case. If a stream has constant/invalid distance values, the chart emits NaN coordinates and breaks rendering.
